detail.title: Intex Cool Star HC 110 – 110 Litres Desert Air Cooler
detail.overview: Long Air Throw | High-Capacity Cooling | Inverter-Compatible | Collapsible Louvres | 1-Year Warranty Overview Stay comfortably cool through peak summer with the Intex Cool Star HC 110, a high-capacity desert air cooler engineered for powerful, long-duration cooling in large spaces. Designed for Indian weather conditions, this cooler combines strong airflow, efficient cooling technology, and durable construction to deliver reliable performance day after day. With a large 110-litre water tank, the Cool Star HC 110 supports extended cooling hours with minimal refilling, making it ideal for continuous use in living rooms, halls, offices, and commercial environments. Its 3-sided high-efficiency honeycomb cooling pads enhance water retention and cooling performance, while the 16-inch fan ensures consistent airflow across the room with a long throw. Built with a shock- and rust-proof body, this cooler is designed for longevity. Features like fully collapsible louvres simplify cleaning and maintenance, and inverter compatibility ensures uninterrupted cooling during power cuts or voltage fluctuations. The Cool Star HC 110 is a dependable solution for users who need strong cooling performance with low operational hassle. Product Highlights High-Capacity 110 Litre Water Tank The large tank capacity enables uninterrupted cooling for long hours, reducing the need for frequent refills and making it suitable for extended daily use. Powerful Air Throw for Large Spaces Equipped with a robust 16-inch fan, the cooler delivers strong airflow with wide coverage, ensuring effective cooling even in spacious rooms and open areas. 3-Side Honeycomb Cooling Pads High-density honeycomb pads on three sides improve water absorption and retention, resulting in efficient and consistent cooling in hot and dry climates. Inverter Compatible Operation Designed to function smoothly on home inverters, the cooler continues to operate reliably during power outages, offering peace of mind in areas with unstable electricity. Collapsible Louvres for Easy Maintenance Fully collapsible louvres allow easy access for cleaning and upkeep, helping maintain cooling efficiency over multiple seasons. Durable, Rust-Proof Construction The shock- and rust-resistant body ensures long-term durability, even with regular use in demanding environments. Ideal For: Large living rooms, halls, open-plan homes, offices, showrooms, and commercial spaces that require high-capacity cooling with strong air throw and minimal refilling.
